warning.titlePre: Mercedes Sprinter 313–319 CDI Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Sprinter has the OM651 4-cylinder diesel — that's the NCV3 generation — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared with the wider Mercedes commercial range. We replace worn injector seals, timing chain components, EGR valves and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

If your Sprinter has the OM642 V6 diesel — also in the NCV3 generation — swirl flap and injector wear is the established pattern. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established commercial vehicle specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-sprinter.md
